T6A3F.regime: temperature difference across the wall <= 75 K (foam intact)

TB011.regime: temperature difference across the wall <= 75 K (foam intact)

notes: R_brick = 0.20/(0.8*12) = 0.020833 K/W, R_foam = 0.05/(0.04*12) = 0.104167 K/W, total 0.125 K/W; Q = 20/0.125 = 160 W. With dT raised by 13 K to 33 K: Q = 264 W. Absolute cold-face temperature 276 K does not enter with constant k (C). Foam-failure threshold 75 K is above both 20 K and 33 K (K). 'A few kelvin' sentences (TA69F, TC890) state no number, unlike their 13 K counterparts (T3307, T9459); whether that is intended depends on the pairing claims. TFB61 ('raised just before the heat flow was measured') sits a little uneasily with 'steady' flow, but most naturally reads as the measured steady state at 33 K.
